defmodule DistCache.Client do
  @moduledoc """
  Distributed cache client with connection pooling and automatic reconnection.
  Uses ETS tables for local caching with configurable TTL.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  defstruct [:pool_ref, :ets_table, :config, :monitors, :pending_ops]

  @default_config %{
    pool_size: 5,
    ttl_ms: 30_000,
    reconnect_interval: 1_000,
    max_retries: 3
  }

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def get(key, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get, key, opts})
  end

  def put(key, value, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:put, key, value, opts})
  end

  def invalidate(key) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:invalidate, key})
  end

  def flush do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :flush)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    config = build_config(opts)
    table = create_cache_table(config)
    pool_ref = init_connection_pool(config)
    monitors = %{}

    schedule_ttl_sweep(config.ttl_ms)

    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      pool_ref: pool_ref,
      ets_table: table,
      config: config,
      monitors: monitors,
      pending_ops: :queue.new()
    }}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get, key, opts}, from, state) do
    case local_lookup(state.ets_table, key) do
      {:ok, value, _meta} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, value}, state}
      :miss ->
        state = enqueue_remote_fetch(state, key, from, opts)
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:put, key, value, opts}, _from, state) do
    ttl = Keyword.get(opts, :ttl, state.config.ttl_ms)
    meta = %{inserted_at: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond), ttl: ttl}
    :ets.insert(state.ets_table, {key, value, meta})
    broadcast_invalidation(state, key, value)
    {:reply, :ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:invalidate, key}, _from, state) do
    :ets.delete(state.ets_table, key)
    {:reply, :ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:flush, _from, state) do
    old_table = state.ets_table
    new_table = create_cache_table(state.config)
    # Schedule deletion of old table after pending reads complete
    schedule_table_deletion(old_table, compute_drain_timeout(state))
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | ets_table: new_table}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:remote_result, key, result, from}, state) do
    case result do
      {:ok, value} ->
        meta = %{inserted_at: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond), ttl: state.config.ttl_ms}
        :ets.insert(state.ets_table, {key, value, meta})
        GenServer.reply(from, {:ok, value})
      {:error, reason} ->
        GenServer.reply(from, {:error, reason})
    end
    {:noreply, drain_pending(state)}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:sweep_expired}, state) do
    sweep_expired_entries(state.ets_table, state.config.ttl_ms)
    schedule_ttl_sweep(state.config.ttl_ms)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:delete_table, table_ref}, state) do
    safely_delete_table(table_ref)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:DOWN, monitor_ref, :process, pid, reason}, state) do
    Logger.warn("Pool worker #{inspect(pid)} down: #{inspect(reason)}")
    monitors = Map.delete(state.monitors, monitor_ref)
    state = %{state | monitors: monitors}
    state = maybe_reconnect(state, pid, reason)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  # Private functions

  defp build_config(opts) do
    env_config = %{
      pool_size: get_env_int("CACHE_POOL_SIZE", @default_config.pool_size),
      ttl_ms: get_env_int("CACHE_TTL_MS", @default_config.ttl_ms),
      reconnect_interval: get_env_int("CACHE_RECONNECT_MS", @default_config.reconnect_interval),
      max_retries: get_env_int("CACHE_MAX_RETRIES", @default_config.max_retries)
    }

    Map.merge(env_config, Map.new(opts))
  end

  defp get_env_int(var, default) do
    case System.get_env(var) do
      nil -> default
      val -> String.to_integer(val)
    end
  end

  defp create_cache_table(config) do
    table_opts = [:set, :public, read_concurrency: true]
    :ets.new(:dist_cache_data, table_opts)
  end

  defp init_connection_pool(config) do
    # Simulated pool initialization
    pool_opts = [
      size: config.pool_size,
      max_overflow: config.pool_size * 2
    ]
    {:pool, pool_opts}
  end

  defp local_lookup(table, key) do
    case :ets.lookup(table, key) do
      [{^key, value, meta}] ->
        if entry_expired?(meta) do
          :ets.delete(table, key)
          :miss
        else
          {:ok, value, meta}
        end
      [] ->
        :miss
    end
  end

  defp entry_expired?(meta) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    now - meta.inserted_at > meta.ttl
  end

  defp enqueue_remote_fetch(state, key, from, opts) do
    op = {:fetch, key, from, opts, System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}
    pending = :queue.in(op, state.pending_ops)
    spawn_remote_fetch(state, key, from, opts)
    %{state | pending_ops: pending}
  end

  defp spawn_remote_fetch(state, key, from, opts) do
    parent = self()
    spawn(fn ->
      result = simulate_remote_get(key, opts)
      send(parent, {:remote_result, key, result, from})
    end)
  end

  defp simulate_remote_get(key, _opts) do
    Process.sleep(Enum.random(10..100))
    {:ok, "value_for_#{key}"}
  end

  defp drain_pending(state) do
    case :queue.out(state.pending_ops) do
      {{:value, _op}, rest} -> %{state | pending_ops: rest}
      {:empty, _} -> state
    end
  end

  defp schedule_ttl_sweep(interval) do
    Process.send_after(self(), {:sweep_expired}, interval)
  end

  defp sweep_expired_entries(table, _ttl_ms) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    # Use select_delete for atomic sweep
    match_spec = [{{:_, :_, %{inserted_at: :"$1", ttl: :"$2"}},
      [{:>, {:-, now, :"$1"}, :"$2"}], [true]}]
    :ets.select_delete(table, match_spec)
  end

  defp schedule_table_deletion(table_ref, timeout) do
    Process.send_after(self(), {:delete_table, table_ref}, timeout)
  end

  defp compute_drain_timeout(state) do
    # Use environment variable for drain timeout
    # In production this allows tuning based on load
    base_timeout = get_env_int("CACHE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS", 0)
    pending_count = :queue.len(state.pending_ops)
    base_timeout + (pending_count * 10)
  end

  defp safely_delete_table(table_ref) do
    try do
      :ets.delete(table_ref)
    rescue
      ArgumentError -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp broadcast_invalidation(_state, _key, _value) do
    # In production, broadcast to cluster nodes
    :ok
  end

  defp maybe_reconnect(state, _pid, _reason) do
    Process.send_after(self(), :reconnect, state.config.reconnect_interval)
    state
  end
end
